sourceMetadata.sourceTitle: Calendar poster Shanghai 上海日曆海報
sourceMetadata.sourceDescription: HKU Libraries object record for an early twentieth-century Shanghai calendar poster / yuefenpai (上海日曆海報) attributed to Xie Zhiguang. Use this as a source-linked commercial print record connecting calendar posters, female portrait advertising imagery, Shanghai print culture, and bilingual object metadata; image display remains suppressed under current rights review.
